subject.title: Add a slim Docker image mode with configurable APT package installation

question: Should OpenClaw add an official Docker package-customization workflow beyond the current build-time `OPENCLAW_IMAGE_APT_PACKAGES` ARG, and if so should it be a derived-image prebuild path or a startup installer?
rationale: The remaining work changes Docker setup semantics, package-manager trust, non-root startup behavior, and outage characteristics, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Approve derived-image prebuild
options.body: Add a documented command or setup path that builds a local image from the selected official image before restarting the gateway.

options.title: Keep build-time only
options.body: Treat the current Dockerfile build arg and custom Dockerfile pattern as the supported contract, then close or document this as intentionally out of scope.

options.title: Allow startup installer
options.body: Add an explicit dev/convenience startup installer with clear root, caching, failure, and downtime warnings.

recommendation.title: Approve derived-image prebuild
recommendation.body: Add a documented command or setup path that builds a local image from the selected official image before restarting the gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: The best available routing signal is prior ownership of the slim official image boundary that this decision would change.
